paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
1. Iki wyawasthaning Sang Hyang mantra, ... Hyang Titiksanotama,
2. pangempuning rasa Hyang Raditya, ... mantra: Ong sang akasti kreket,
3. mala paksi tikreket manohara, lingnye mantra Titiksanotama,
4. Hyang Titiksanotama mantraning tamba ... kreket teka swara hang.

[Lembar 2]
1. Hyang mantraning kreket tikasa, Titiksanotama mantraning kreket,
2. mangkana kunang Hyang mantraning kreket, kreket umarang yang mantrah,
3. mwang mantraning Titiksanotama iki, mantraning Hyang mantraning pustaka,
4. iki Titiksanotama mantraning Sang Hyang ...
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Inilah ketentuan/penjelasan mengenai Sang Hyang Mantra, ... Hyang Titiksanotama, pemelihara rasa Hyang Raditya (Dewa Matahari), ... mantranya: 'Ong sang akasti kreket, mala paksi tikreket manohara...', demikian bunyi mantra Titiksanotama, Hyang Titiksanotama mantra pengobatan ... kreket bersuara hang.

[Lembar 2]
Hyang mantra dari kreket ..., Titiksanotama mantra kreket, demikianlah Hyang mantra dari kreket, kreket menyertai mantra tersebut, serta mantra Titiksanotama ini, mantra suci dari pustaka, inilah Titiksanotama mantra Sang Hyang ...
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
This is the provision/exposition of the Sacred Mantra, ... Hyang Titiksanotama, guardian of the essence of Hyang Raditya (the Sun Deity), ... the mantra: 'Ong sang akasti kreket, mala paksi tikreket manohara...', thus sounds the Titiksanotama mantra, Hyang Titiksanotama the incantation for medicine ... kreket sound hang.

[Leaf 2]
Hyang mantra of kreket ..., Titiksanotama the kreket mantra, such is the Hyang mantra of kreket, kreket accompanying the mantra, as well as this Titiksanotama mantra, the sacred mantra of the lontar manuscript, this is Titiksanotama the sacred mantra of Sang Hyang ...

paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
iki swarangané tan wruh ring sampurna, ong ngaranya luhung kita ring hyang guru swara.
panunggalan ikang rasa, ong rasaning rasa siddhi, ya sampurna kita ring rasa.
sama pakirti tan wruh rasaning raswara, sira guru manglas ri tan wruh rasa.
sira tan wruh ring manglas sing rasa, rasa-rasaning sira sing anarasa.

[Lembar 2]
sira manglas sing rasa rasaning kawirasa, rasing manglas ri tan wruh rasaning.
rasa tanarasa sira manglas ring rasa, rasa-rasaning hurip layu sampurna.
sira manglas ring ingsri tan wruh rasa, siddhi ring sira manglas ring ipunya.
sira ipunya sira manglas ring sungsung, iyokyan sungsung ing rayanya.
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Inilah suara/ajaran bagi yang belum memahami kesempurnaan. Om namanya yang luhur engkau pada Hyang Guru Swara.
Penyatuan rasa, Om intisari dari segala rasa utama yang sakti, itulah kesempurnaan engkau di dalam rasa.
Bersama bertingkah laku yang belum mengetahui intisari suara rasa, beliaulah guru yang melepaskan/menguraikan bagi yang tidak memahami rasa.
Beliau tidak mengetahui pelepasan setiap rasa, rasa-rasa dari beliau bagi yang merasakan.

[Lembar 2]
Beliau yang melepaskan dari rasa, intisari ajaran kawirasa, intisari pelepasan bagi yang tidak memahami rasa.
Rasa tiada rasa beliau melepaskan dalam rasa, intisari kehidupan menuju kesempurnaan sejati.
Beliau melepaskan dalam sari bagi yang tidak memahami rasa, keberhasilan pada beliau melepaskan padanya.
Beliau adalah hakikatnya yang menguraikan dalam pemujaan, senantiasa dipuja di dalam jalannya.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
This is the teaching for those who do not yet comprehend spiritual perfection. 'Om' is the exalted name unto Hyang Guru Swara.
The union of the essence/feeling, 'Om' the essence of all realized/sacred essence, that is your perfection within the rasa.
Engaged together without understanding the essence of the inner voice/rasa, the master discerns and separates for those unaware of the essence.
He does not discern each detached rasa, the inner tastes of whoever experiences them.

[Leaf 2]
He who detaches from rasa, the essence of poetic/spiritual wisdom, the essence of detachment for those not yet knowing the essence.
Essence beyond sensation, he detaches in essence, the supreme essence of life dissolves into perfection.
He detaches within the sacred essence for those ignorant of it, achieving spiritual power in detachment unto itself.
He is the reality who detaches in reverence, ever venerated along the spiritual path.

paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
akilwangantara ruharing ongkara, angga telu mating ayung asring karingka,
pangantupa sira isep ranying ryang asih, asting rasa kusamadhi sritika,
yalapakiritan ring ongkara ngiring yogya, gingrurang langgeng samadhi ring ongkaraka,
ngiring ratu rasring anglanggengsing asih, ring ongkara ngiring kaswargan asih.

[Lembar 2]
hing anglanggengsing asih ring ongkara ngikiyan, ring hing anglanggengsing tan ring ongkara ngiring,
ran gata gata hing anglanggengsing asih, ring ongkara ngiring umanten mlangkang asih,
sing anglanggengsing iswaritika sang asih, mwang ring hing anglanggengsing impupalangka,
sing impupalangka sing anglanggengsing asih, iyeng ruwing sangsing hitaruwing sangsing.
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Petunjuk spiritual/kegaiban mengenai aksara suci Ongkara, perwujudan tiga aspek ketuhanan yang senantiasa diiringi pemusatan cipta dan asih, berserah diri dalam ketenangan samadhi pada Ongkara menuju keutamaan dan kebahagiaan surgawi.

[Lembar 2]
Kelanjutan peneguhan keheningan dan ketetapan rasa bhakti (langgeng asih) pada hakikat suci Ongkara, keagungan Iswara, serta keluhuran batin yang membawa ketenteraman.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
Spiritual teachings on the esoteric mystery of the sacred syllable Ongkara, embodying the threefold divinity accompanied by focused meditation and divine love (asih), immersing oneself in steady samadhi upon Ongkara towards supreme spiritual state and heavenly bliss.

[Leaf 2]
Continuation of the establishment of steadfast devotion and contemplation (langgeng asih) upon the sacred Ongkara, the grace of Iswara, and supreme inner peace.

kasiddhiyan tindik ngaliṅgāyangaken sthilayi, mantra, oṁ huṁ soṁ roṁ stiyaṅ rāja,

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
...keteguhan/kedudukan sthilayi, kemunculan laya, Indra, takut akan wujud sthilayi, keadaan halus tak berwujud,
Indrani, keteguhan yang agung, kemunculan yang agung, Vidyarajni berwujud keteguhan,
Yamarajni berwujud keteguhan, dalam perpisahan keteguhan, inilah tempat persemayaman dalam keksatriaan,
kesaktian/keberhasilan serta pemantapan mantra sakti.

Kesaktian perihal menegakkan kedudukan sthilayi, mantra: 'Om hum som rom stiyang raja,
Om hum rajarajni kasulingan tiran dewi', yang bersifat suksema (halus) tidak terdengar suaranya,
dalam menjaga umur panjang pada kepanasan berbakti dua raja maut (Yama), hidup dalam keutamaan dua kedudukan,
penstanaan/pengukuhan kesaktian dewata mantra.

Yamarajni embodied in stillness, in separation of stillness, this is the seat/embodiment in ksatriya nobility,
spiritual accomplishment and establishing powerful sacred mantras.

[Leaf 2]
Accomplishment concerning the establishing of the spiritual seat, mantra: 'Om hum som rom stiyang raja,
Om hum rajarajni kasulingan tiran dewi', subtle and imperceptible without audible sound,
in guarding longevity amidst affliction, devotion unto the sovereign realm of Yama, living in excellence of established seats,
the enshrinement of the divine powers of sacred mantra.

The subsequent leaf contains mystical incantations ('kreket' related to ratri, rahu, rudra, and kala) invoked for protection, potency, purification, and spiritual peace.

karmmī atmakingkalpa, tūtwakalparihingit: pratyakṣa, yityantolwirṇyātmaka atma pra-

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Penjelasan mengenai pengetahuan seorang yogi, itulah yogi dalam tahapan kalpa. Keheningan batin yogi, konsentrasi sang yogi. Kalpa dalam pemusatan mantra, kalpa tentang kematian dan keutamaan persepsi langsung (pratyaksa). Demikianlah aturan-aturan dalam pelaksanaan kalpa, yang mengarahkan pikiran pada kesucian batin. Pelaksanaan tindakan suci menurut ajaran kalpa. Jika tiada keteguhan batin dalam tindakan.

[Lembar 2]
Perbuatan batiniah kalpa, selaras dengan makna kalpa: persepsi langsung (pratyaksa), demikianlah wujud hakikat sang jiwa, pratyaksa yang sejati, tiada berpaling dari keutamaan asal. Ketiadaan rintangan dalam yoga yang layak, penyerahan diri secara batiniah mengikuti jalan persepsi langsung batiniah, wujud jiwa yang menyatu dalam perenungan kalpa diri, senantiasa menjaga keheningan jiwa.
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Exposition regarding the wisdom of a yogi, that is the yogi within the kalpa stage. 3 in the clarity of the yogi's noble mind, the contemplation of the yogi. Kalpa in the subtle intent of mantras, kalpa on death and the noble direct perception (pratyakṣa). Thus are the mental procedures in the performance of kalpa, directing the movement of mind toward inner sanctity. Spiritual actions following the discipline of kalpa. If there is no steadfastness in performing such duties.

[Lembar 2]
Spiritual duties of the inner kalpa, following the true meaning of kalpa: direct perception (pratyakṣa), such is the nature of the self/soul, authentic direct perception, never turning away from the primordial essence. Free from great obstacles suitable for yoga, relinquishment directed inward, following the path of direct spiritual insight, the nature of the soul adhering to the discipline of the self, continually guarding the purity of the soul.
